$comment: Hand-written. Structure only: roles, repetition, arity. No pixels, no colour, no copy.
approvalNote: UNAPPROVED. Traced and rendered, not yet read against ref.png by a human. Nothing generates from this until approvedBy is set.

regions.note: Two lines at the measured size. The subject of the whole grid, not of any one item.

children.note: The one orange text moment. Names the principle the items are instances of.
Ends by handing over to the items — the source uses a literal arrow.

invariants: The intro column is NARROWER than an item column and is not one of the items. Making them equal turns this into a plain column set and loses the argument-then-instances reading.
Items fill a 3-wide grid across two rows. Five items leaves one cell empty by design; six fills it. Four or fewer should use a single row and a different template.
Item labels share a baseline row so bodies start level even when a label wraps. Two of the five wrap in the source.
Exactly one orange text moment: the intro lead. The dots are orange; nothing else is.

grounds.note: One ground. The structure does the separating.
